name: io.github.2016judea/travel-intelligence
title: Travel Intelligence
description: Sourced destination research, hotel comparisons and itinerary checks for travel advisors

tools.name: research_destination
tools.description:
Structured destination intelligence for a client brief in a covered city: ranked neighbourhoods with counts (hotels, independent restaurants, museums, heritage sites), sights matched to the client's interests with opening hours on their dates and when those hours were last confirmed, dining areas, a hotel shortlist, airports and transit, sun and golden-hour times, public and school holidays on the dates, monthly climate, warnings, and rule-based experience ideas. Every item carries its source and evidence tier. Costs 1 credit (free on the paid plan).

Examples:
- "Seven days in Lisbon for a couple in their early 40s who love architecture, independent restaurants and photography, and want to avoid tourist traps"
- "What should a family know about Rome from 14 to 18 April 2027?"
- "Best neighbourhoods in Barcelona for a design-focused client"

destination.description: City, e.g. 'Lisbon', 'Porto', 'Paris'. get_usage_balance lists the covered cities.

start_date.description: First day of the trip, YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: Last day of the trip, YYYY-MM-DD.

traveler_profile.description: e.g. 'couple in their early 40s', 'family with two children under 10'.

budget.description: Maps to hotel star bands (budget ≤2★, moderate 3★, upscale 4★, luxury 5★). Stars are a classification, not a price.

tools.name: compare_hotels
tools.description:
Side-by-side comparison of hotels in a covered city, either the properties you name (up to 10) or a shortlist from filters. For each: official classification, rooms, brand or independent, the building's date, architect, style and heritage status where recorded, recorded amenities, a working official website (we check it), neighbourhood, walkability (nearest station, sights within 1 km, restaurants within 500 m), who it suits and its drawbacks by stated rules, sources and last-verified dates. Names we can't find are listed under not_found, never guessed. Pricing and availability are not_available (no licensed rates source is connected). Costs 2 credits for up to 5 hotels, 3 for 6–10 (free on the paid plan).

Examples:
- "Compare Memmo Alfama, Santiago de Alfama and Bairro Alto Hotel for a couple who want a quiet, historic, walkable base"
- "Five independent boutique hotels in Le Marais near the metro"
- "Upscale hotels in Porto's Ribeira with a working website"

hotel_names.description: Specific properties to compare, as the client or advisor names them.

start_date.description: Check-in, YYYY-MM-DD (used only if a rates provider is connected).

budget.description: Maps to hotel star bands (budget ≤2★, moderate 3★, upscale 4★, luxury 5★). Stars are a classification, not a price.

amenities.description: e.g. ['wheelchair access', 'wifi', 'parking', 'pool']. Reported as recorded yes/no or not recorded.

neighborhoods.description: Limit a shortlist to these neighbourhoods, e.g. ['Alfama', 'Chiado'].

max_results.description: Shortlist size when no names are given (default 5). 6 or more costs 3 credits.

criteria.description: Other comparison criteria in plain words.

tools.name: validate_itinerary
tools.description:
Checks whether a day-by-day itinerary works: locates each stop, computes travel time between consecutive stops by walking, transit or taxi, and flags overlaps, too-tight transfers, venues closed on that weekday or at that time (from published opening hours, with when they were last confirmed), public holidays, overloaded days, long walking, backtracking (with a better order), city-to-city moves with time ranges by rail, flight and road, and flight check-in buffers. Returns a status, issues by severity with evidence and a fix, and the computed timeline. Deterministic calculations, not opinions. Costs 2 credits (free on the paid plan).

Examples:
- "Check this Lisbon day: Jerónimos 9:00, Belém Tower 10:00, Castelo de São Jorge 11:00, LX Factory 12:30, Gulbenkian 14:00"
- "Is Paris Monday 3 May 2027 Louvre then Orsay then Sacré-Cœur realistic?"
- "Validate this 10-day Portugal and Spain itinerary for a client using a wheelchair"

city.description: City for this day; carries forward to later days.

lodging.description: Hotel name for the night (the day starts and ends there).

name.description: Venue or activity as written, e.g. 'Jerónimos Monastery', 'Lunch at Taberna da Rua das Flores'.

start_date.description: Date of day 1 when days carry no dates.

destination.description: Default city when days don't name one.

transport.description: Default 'mixed': walk up to max_walk_minutes, else transit.

max_walk_minutes.description: Longest walk the client accepts per leg (default 25; 10 with limited mobility).

pace.description: Default 'moderate' (about 8 h of activities a day).

tools.name: get_usage_balance
tools.description:
Free. The connected account's plan (free or paid), credits left, when the daily free credits reset, billing status, what each tool costs, and the destinations covered.

Examples:
- "How many Travel Intelligence credits do I have left?"
- "Which cities does Travel Intelligence cover?"
- "Am I on the paid plan?"
